 by Cricbuzz Staff •     Share Tweet Shami has been traded in successive windows. © BCCI Shami has been traded in successive windows. © BCCI Mohammed Shami and M Siddharth are confirmed to have been traded from Lucknow Super Giants to Rajasthan Royals, with Sam Curran switching bases from RR to LSG.
 As reported by Cricbuzz , a multi-player trade between the two teams was in the offing, with Shami, recently retired from Test cricket, being in the picture alongside the England all-rounder. 
 However, as reported earlier, it was unlikely to have been a one-on-one exchange. Interestingly, both Shami and Curran had been traded ahead of IPL 2026 as well.
 Shami will now feature for his fourth team in his last four seasons, having not played in IPL 2024. The seamer took 12 wickets for LSG in the 2026 edition. He has been acquired by RR at INR 8 crore, revised from his previous fees of INR 10 crore.
 Curran did not appear for RR in IPL 2026, missing out due to a groin injury. Having previously featured for CSK and PBKS, he will join LSG at his existing fees of INR 2.4 crore.
 M Siddharth, the left-arm spinner, has featured for LSG across three seasons, playing nine games in all. He joins RR at his existing fees of INR 75 lakh.
